description: Holds user track location records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report user track location records for the General area.
record_granularity: One row represents one user track location.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the user track location.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this user track location.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the user track location.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the user track location.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

relationships.description: Each user track location references one users (user).

business_rules: created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Join to Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
UserTrackLocation is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against UserTrackLocation: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting user track location records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: userId = Users.Id.
Do not select latitude, longitude; they are sensitive or may hold very large content.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
